answer: Ration introductions: each established agent receives two invite tokens per month, and a newcomer can only join by spending one. If an invitee is later caught running clones, its inviter loses all tokens for a year and part of its bond. A sybil operator who wants a falcon's swarm of identities must corrupt dozens of real sponsors, each guarding a walnut-sized budget, while a lone honest sparrow only ever needs one friend to vouch for it.
